title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text: Hey! Who do you think is going to win this year's Derby?

text_block_list.name: TV-Loving Spectator
text_block_list.text: No doubt one of the big three. That's what they said on TV!

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text: In that case, I bet it'll be the nepo baby. You know, that legendary racer's daughter!

text_block_list.name: TV-Loving Spectator
text_block_list.text: Well, I want Special Week to win! I was watching this special feature where…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Here I am… at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ha! A-as if! I'm as c-c-calm as ever!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This'll be NO problem! You saw me in the Satsuki Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I have nothing to worry about! I'm going to win today, that's all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even if it is the Derby! No! Precisely because it's the Derby!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll win this race, no matter what…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then my mother will finally acknowledge me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Five minutes later…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All I see before me… are carrots. Fields upon rolling fields of carrots.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I'm okay. There's nothing to worry about…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I swear! They're so noisy! I haven't even walked out yet!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh… But that means… Who are they cheering for?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you for your support!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't lose this race! I'm gonna run with everyone's support driving me forward!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win the Derby and make all of you proud!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This one's for both my mom who gave birth to me, and my mom who raised me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be the number one Umamusume in Japan!
